title: Randomized Clinical Trial of Bococizumab (PF-04950615; RN316) in Subjects Who Are Intolerant to Statins

sections.abstract:
This study is a multicenter, double blinded, active and placebo controlled randomized clinical trial to demonstrate a superior lipid lowering effect of Bococizumab (PF-04950615; RN316) compared to placebo in subjects who are statin intolerant.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline in Fasting Low Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) at Week 12. timeframe=Baseline, Week 12. Placebo=2.4 (±12.86); PF-04950615 150 Milligram (mg) + Placebo=-52.0 (±22.75); Atorvastatin 40 mg + Placebo=-32.6 (±20.98). p=<0.001
